verdict.rationale: LangGraph natively supports durable execution via checkpointers (Postgres-backed for production) that persist thread state, allow resuming after failures, and explicitly advertise 'persist through failures and can run for extended periods, automatically resuming from exactly where they left off.' However, community feedback notes persistence/streaming implementations are less mature than claimed and questions remain about robust production deployment beyond local serve. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of surviving actual process restarts/deploys in production, details on durable-execution integrations (e.g. Temporal) beyond native checkpointing, and confirmation that the community concerns about persistence maturity have been resolved.
